texts: The modified Bentall operation replaces the aortic valve and root with a composite valve graft, the bendy straw with dentures built in, and all four statements are true, so the answer is all of the above: E.
The coronary arteries are cut out as round buttons and reimplanted separately, the two crown spikes sewn on one by one.
The technique was popularised by Kouchoukos, the chef with the couscous, and it is today the preferred way to replace the aortic root, the gold rosette.
Sewing the buttons on directly prevents the pseudoaneurysms at the coronary ostia that the older inclusion technique caused, the bubbles with fake moustaches.
Memory hook: a bendy straw with dentures, two crown buttons sewn on one by one, a pot of couscous, and no fake moustaches.
